lines.1: 「More importantly, today we clean the house. The little corners are dirty, so let us give it a thorough cleaning and make it pleasant to live in.」
lines.2: She really was serious about everything...
lines.3: 「By the way, try this rice ball as well.」
lines.4: She held it out to me.
lines.7: She really would put anything in a rice ball.
lines.9: We tackled the cleaning in earnest. Otome weeded the garden.
lines.10: 「I am poor at intricate work. Simple physical labor like this suits me.」
lines.14: The spare cleaner for the rag was in the washroom, right?
